text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Doubling as preparation for regional races, our senior-year summer camp officially begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru vows to do everything she can during the grueling summer training to show just how far she's come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Intent on making her own luck through diligent effort, she leaps into action under the bright summer sky.
